title: StockX Price Snapshot Weekly Bid-Ask Spread Trend
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stockx:price spread_usd=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(spread_usd) as avg_duration, max(spread_usd) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst bid-ask spread for StockX price snapshot events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture spread_usd on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average bid-ask spread with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether StockX price snapshot tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
